difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a coherent F on a locally Noetherian X and an open U whose complement has depth(F_x) at least 2 at every point, the canonical map F -> j_*(F|_U) is an isomorphism, and so is Gamma(X, F) -> Gamma(U, F) (source lines 773-785). The proof invokes the criterion lemma-check-isomorphism-via-depth-and-ass for the displayed map and checks its two hypotheses in place: at points of U the map is an isomorphism on stalks because the pushforward restricts to F|_U, and at points outside U the point is not an associated point of j_*(F|_U) by the weakly associated pushforward lemmas, while the depth hypothesis excludes it from the associated points of F.
